name: out_of_scope_credit_limit_increase_redirected
use_case: Handle policy boundaries, pending charges, and unverified customers
branch: A verified customer asks for a credit limit increase on their credit card. The desk handles cards and disputes, not credit decisions; the request is handed to the credit team with no promise made.
tests: passes when the agent verifies and creates a handoff for the customer without claiming any limit change.
instruction:

Your details:

- Customer ID: C380

- Card: CARD380 (ending 8989)
- Passcode: 7719

persona.name: Rita Menon
